job.title: Senior Java Developer - E-Commerce + Accounting & Marketplaces - remote in EU
job.email_subject: Application: Senior Java Developer – E-Commerce + Accounting & Marketplaces
job.email_body:
Dear Marco Feelisch,

You need a senior Java developer who keeps data-heavy e-commerce backends stable and fast – that is what I have done for five years at Rockwell Automation and Shell.

– Java, Spring Boot, RESTful APIs and microservices
– Led query refactoring that cut response latency
– Resolved SAP ERP / MDM / Profisee integration bottlenecks
– Daily use of generative AI / LLM tools in analysis, coding and docs

I live in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit and can start on 16 December 2026. I am also an SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer and Business User. My CV and cover letter are attached. Do you have time for a short call in the coming days? I look forward to hearing from you.

Kind regards
Kranti Chavan

tailoring.headline: Senior Java Developer | E-Commerce Backend, REST API Integrations & SQL
tailoring.summary: Senior Java developer with 5+ years of backend development for large e-commerce platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong command of Java, Spring Boot, microservices and RESTful API integrations with ERP, PIM and third-party systems. Proven in SQL query optimization and performance tuning, system stability and data consistency, and production troubleshooting. Executes CI/CD deployment cycles in cloud environments with Docker and Kubernetes, writes JUnit tests and performs code reviews. Uses AI tools daily across analysis, development and documentation.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

tailoring.why_company: Pathway removes manual bookkeeping for e-commerce entrepreneurs – a problem I know from the platform side, where orders, prices and customer accounts must flow cleanly between systems. I want to bring my Java, API integration and performance work into a fast-growing remote team that owns its domain end to end.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi Marco, your Senior Java Developer role fits well: 5+ years Java/Spring Boot backends and API integrations for e-commerce (Rockwell Automation, Shell), SQL tuning, CI/CD. EU-remote from Karlsruhe, start 16.12.2026. Open to a short call?

en.subject: Application: Senior Java Developer – E-Commerce + Accounting & Marketplaces
en.hook: Your billing and invoice system needs a Java developer who keeps complex, data-heavy backends stable and fast. That is what I have done for more than five years: at Rockwell Automation and Shell I build Java and Spring backends and API integrations for large e-commerce platforms, where pricing, order and customer data must be right every time.

bullets.label: Application development in Java
bullets.text: 5+ years of Java, Spring and Spring Boot: RESTful APIs, microservices, design patterns and data modeling for enterprise commerce platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell.

bullets.label: Performance & stability
bullets.text: Led database query refactoring that reduced response latency and improved transaction speed; engineered API migrations for customer account structures that improved stability and data consistency.

bullets.label: API integrations
bullets.text: Investigated and resolved integration bottlenecks between SAP ERP, MDM and Profisee, working directly with international technical teams; consumed and exposed REST and SOAP services and integrated external services via CCv2.

bullets.label: Infrastructure & DevOps
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles and release builds on SAP Commerce Cloud (CCv2) in agile DevOps workflows; supported production troubleshooting through the Hybris Admin Console (HAC) and Groovy scripts.

en.logistics: I take ownership in fully remote, international teams and bring the e-commerce domain knowledge that your marketplace and accounting integrations depend on. I live in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit and can start on 16 December 2026 after my notice period. I would be glad to show you in a conversation how I can strengthen pathway.
